crossRefs.note: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”
Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land…
As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on…
The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will…
“For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,
but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave…
to fulfill Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. As long as it lay desolate, it…

translations.web: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to Yahweh. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.
translations.bsb: But in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of complete rest for the land—a Sabbath to the LORD. You are not to sow your field or prune your vineyard.
translations.kjv: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
translations.asv: but in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a sabbath unto Jehovah: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
